---
title: "Global Temperature Trends"
subtitle: "NASA GISTEMP land-ocean temperature anomalies, 1880 to present"
---

## About this site

This site visualizes how global surface temperatures have changed since 1880, using the NASA GISS Surface Temperature Analysis (GISTEMP v4).

Values are **temperature anomalies**: how much warmer or cooler a period was compared with the 1951–1980 average, in degrees Celsius.

## What's inside

The [**Dashboard**](dashboard.qmd) includes:

- Summary numbers: latest full year and warmest year on record
- Three line charts of the annual anomaly
  - a basic line chart
  - a styled line chart
  - the annual values with a 5-year rolling average
- An animated chart of monthly anomalies, year by year

## Data source

NASA Goddard Institute for Space Studies, [GISS Surface Temperature Analysis](https://data.giss.nasa.gov/gistemp/). The data is downloaded each time the site is rendered, so rebuilding the site picks up NASA's latest update.

::: callout-note
The current year is incomplete, so it has no annual (J–D) value. It is left out of the annual charts but appears in the monthly animation.
:::
